capabilities: Navigate to the next/previous file in the current folder
Navigate to older/newer files by creation or modification timestamp
Move up/down between folders and to the next/previous folder
Navigate via mobile floating button gestures
Configure sort order, file types, looping, and cross-folder continuation
extras: Vim keybinding support works only when editor mode is on, per the README caveat.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to step through sibling files in a folder without repeatedly using the file explorer.

relations.evidence: Map keys with the obsidian-vimrc-support plugin, for example gn or gp.

summary: Navigation plugin that adds commands and a mobile button to jump to the next or previous file in the current folder.
